acceptedAnswer.text: Zoning regulations for home office additions in Pasadena are managed by the City of Pasadena Planning & Community Development Department. These regulations typically dictate setbacks from property lines, maximum allowable height, lot coverage, and architectural review requirements, especially for properties in historic districts or specific overlay zones. Certain neighborhoods may have stricter guidelines. Understanding these specific local requirements is crucial for project approval. Our team is experienced in navigating Pasadena's zoning ordinances and will ensure your design complies with all local regulations before submitting for permits.
